title: Weighted Edit Distance
statement:
Find the minimum cost to transform string a into b. Insertions, deletions, and replacements have independent costs.

Input
Read two nonempty lowercase strings a and b, then insertion, deletion, and replacement costs. Matching equal letters costs zero.

Output
Print the minimum total cost.

Constraints
1 ≤ |a|,|b| ≤ 4000. Each cost is in [0,10⁹].
